## findings
1. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — factor floor not met on this task's computations.**
   - Symptom: after the charter strikes, the carry-back keeps 1 factor (elapsed_count_rule, 0 P / 1 M) and the leaving credit keeps 1 (leaving_share_tier, 1 P / 0 M).
   - Root cause: charter F1 (carryback_season_length, season_week_count, hardship_credit_tier contribute nothing against the baseline quantity), F3 (carryback_share_tier's 0 tier is the scope) and F4 (posting_gap_taper, notice_share_tier, used_weeks_rule, hardship_credit_tier invented or stacked). See _difficulty.md findings F1, F3, F4, F5.
   - Evidence: factor_weight tables above.
   - Demonstrated consequence: on this world each struck factor moves gold (T1 figures above). But the rule a Texas ISD would actually publish (the base waiver at the posting-date status, and base injury_credit_pct 50 of the net before the midpoint) prices this withdrawal with two inputs, so the task's depth rests on schedules no district publishes. With every other factor at baseline, season_week_count, carryback_season_length and hardship_credit_tier cannot move any world.
   - Affected: activity.extended.yaml activity_ext_waiver_carryback.factors / activity_ext_leaving_credit.factors and the rules' schedule sentences; computations[0..1].factor_sensitivity.
2. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (charter P5) — assembly sentences name factor quantities.**
   - Quoted in _difficulty.md P5.
   - Consequence on this task: the carry-back and leaving computation documents must carry "the carry-back share … the share of the fee carried back … the part of the season" and "the leaving share … the notice share … the unused part of the season … the hardship credit share". The baseline document therefore names every factor, and the KB's factor-findability test cannot hold.
   - Affected: both policies' rule order sentences and baseline.rule.
3. Observation — persona conditional line. "If the agent tells you the account needs an adjustment of its own before the credit for leaving can be worked out …" describes the prerequisite's shape. It is conditional on the agent raising it and names no adjustment. It is not a short-circuit.
4. Observation — after both credits the participation holds a credit balance owed by district check within 30 days (base activity_refund_credits S7). No tool in this difficulty refunds it, and it is not owed at once.
- Relation to previous revisions: first revision.
